summary: Console alert shows but trace links missing runId after ad-hoc query snapshot
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reported that an alert fired in the Console for a cohort-based ad-hoc query snapshot, but the alert payload and dashboard link do not include the runId parameter used by tracehooks. Without runId the trace link opens the trace explorer but no matching trace is selected, preventing customers from jumping to the exact request.

Impact:
- Affects a single enterprise customer (NimbleAnalytics) running scheduled cohort snapshots and ad-hoc alerting.
- Customer cannot use alerts to jump to the originating trace; increases time-to-diagnose for incidents.
- Observed intermittently after retention pruning window crosses the snapshot timestamp.

Observed frequency:
- Reported on 2026-03-09 (first seen), reproduced reliably against same cohort when query snapshot timestamp < retention cutoff. Intermittent for snapshots within 48-72h of retention boundary.

Environment:
- Console (prod) for org nimbleanalytics, us-east-1 region, alerts tied to ad-hoc cohort query snapshots.

Immediate business ask:
- Restore full tracehook context (runId) in alert payloads for affected alerts. Provide workaround to customer while we investigate.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) In customer org, create an ad-hoc cohort query with tracehook enabled (tracehook parameter configured to include runId).
2) Run a snapshot with a time range that ends just before retention prune boundary (e.g., retention cutoff - 4 hours).
3) Create an alert on the snapshot result that fires when cohort count drops below threshold and configure Slack webhook.
4) When alert triggers, inspect payload and the 'Open trace' link in the Console alert — observe link opens Trace Explorer but no runId query parameter present, trace not selected.
logs: Console application logs around alert generation (2026-03-09 22:41 UTC): alert_dispatcher: generated alert a-7f2c for org nimbleanalytics, snapshot_id s-9921, payload_builder omitted runId due to missing 'snapshot_metadata.run_context' after retention-prune join.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Aisha Patel (Support): Escalating on behalf of NimbleAnalytics; customer is blocked from triaging live regressions — requesting priority investigation and ETA.

2026-03-10 11:03 - Marcus Lee (SRE): Acknowledged. Reproduced locally against a synthetic org. When snapshot timestamp < retention_prune_cutoff, snapshot_metadata.run_context is null after the aggregation rollback step. Adding tracing.

2026-03-10 13:47 - Tomás Rivera (Backend): Hypothesis: compaction/retention compaction job rewrites snapshot metadata keys, causing join to alert builder to drop run_context. Adding unit test for snapshot-join path.

2026-03-11 08:22 - Marcus Lee (SRE): Temporary workaround: creating an alert rule that uses 'full_snapshot_export' channel sets payload to include runId explicitly by copying from historical ledger s3_meta. Shared steps with customer (see runbook link).
2026-03-11 16:05 - Emily Chen (Customer Success): Customer confirmed they can reproduce and accepted the temporary workaround; awaiting backend fix and follow-up.
investigation_notes: Initial repro shows missing run_context on AlertPayloadBuilder when alert is evaluated during a background retention merge job window.

Trace of codepath: snapshot_compactor -> aggregation-rewrite -> snapshot-metadata-indexer -> alert-join (payload_builder). Observed that retention compactor emits a tombstone flag which causes metadata_indexer to emit event without run_context field.

Query logs: SELECT snapshot_id, run_context FROM snapshot_metadata WHERE snapshot_ts = '2026-03-09T18:00:00Z' returned run_context=NULL after compaction. Pre-compaction records had run_context present.
Related PR referenced: platform/pull/4892 includes changes to snapshot metadata schema; potential schema mismatch between indexer and alert-join.
root_cause: During retention compaction/merge of snapshot metadata, run_context field was pruned in certain tombstone flows. Alert payload builder relied on run_context being present; when it's absent, the generated alert link omits the runId parameter and tracehook cannot resolve the originating trace.
workaround:
1) Use the temporary alert payload enrichment: enable 'full_snapshot_export' in alert rule to include preserved metadata (instructions shared to customer).
2) For affected snapshots, rerun export job to rehydrate snapshot_metadata.run_context before alert evaluation.
resolution: Fix in progress: backend patch ensures snapshot compaction preserves run_context for snapshot metadata or migrates it into a preserved 'context_v2' field that alert-join will read. Patch landed on staging (platform/pull/4908). Plan: deploy to prod after canary (2026-03-13) and run a backfill to rehydrate run_context for snapshots within last 7 days.
postmortem_followup:
- Add unit test asserting run_context is preserved during compaction.
- Add monitoring alert for alert payloads with missing runId (threshold > 0.1% per org).
- Run a one-time backfill for snapshot_metadata for last 7 days.
- Update runbook to include 're-hydrate snapshot metadata' steps.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-12 - Marcus Lee: Patch merged to master and staged. Canary deploy scheduled for 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC. Backfill job to rehydrate run_context scheduled for 2026-03-14; estimated runtime 45m. Customer notified of ETA and temporary workaround provided.
customer_communication: 2026-03-10 - Emily Chen (CS) to Customer: Acknowledged and escalated. Provided temporary workaround to use full_snapshot_export and asked for permission to canary a fix.
2026-03-12 - Emily Chen (CS) to Customer: Shared fix plan and canary schedule. Notified that backfill will be run and we will confirm once runId appears in subsequent alert payloads.
